line1: Wind farm sheet filed. Telecom isolation confirmed. Deck is clear.
overview: Follow the mud ridge. Frame the shore end with the furrow.
close: Close shot of the seaward sheath. Leave clearance in the crossflow.
haul: Pennant in sight. Confirm from outside the line. Deck handles the lift.
signed: The times match. I’ll sign this page.
partial: Originals filed. Mark the unsurveyed area for the relief watch.
followup: Relief matched the recovered section with marine records. Anchor drag confirmed.
line2: A grey housing appears beside rock at the edge of the last photo. Start there.
frame: Deck fix is jumping. I have the time. Frame rock and housing together. Stand clear.
outside: Vessel closing outside. End survey and back out along your track.
filed: Purpose unknown. Include the original footage.
delay: Night watch sighted the vessel again. Morning lift postponed.
again: R-One, still have video? Let the water clear, then frame the shot.
miss: Window closed. Log the last recognisable feature.
